requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Cloud Adoption Engineer — Oracle Government, Defense & Intelligence 
Build the Foundation for Successful Cloud Adoption
Oracle Government, Defense & Intelligence is seeking a Cloud Adoption Engineer to help U.S. Federal Government customers establish secure, scalable, and operationally ready Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments.

requisitionList.Title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Scaled Manufacturing (SMF) builds and operates container-based services for validating infrastructure across factory environments. SMF enables repeatable production of liquid-cooled GPU platforms - including GB200, GB300, VR, MI355, and MI455 - by embedding quality, yield, throughput, and readiness controls into manufacturing.
SMF delivers factory infrastructure; a Control Plane for test lifecycle management, operator workflows, quality gates, fleet health, and reporting; and a Data Plane that automates tests validation. Manufacturing Repair and Triage identifies root causes, guides recovery and uses data to reduce repeat failures. Working with Supply Chain Operations, Oracle Hardware Development, manufacturing partners, data-center teams, NVIDIA, and AMD, SMF detects hardware, firmware, software, and configuration issues before racks ship. This improves yield, reduces rework and downstream failures, and accelerates reliable AI infrastructure deployment at hyperscale.

requisitionList.Title: Senior Software Engineer, Core Infrastructure
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, troubleshoot, and debug software programs for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

In this position, you will work autonomously with minimal supervision, leveraging exceptional organizational and problem-solving abilities. You will be part of a team of smart, motivated, and diverse people, with the autonomy and support to do your best work in a dynamic and flexible workplace. If you want to build large-scale distributed infrastructure for the cloud, this is your team.

requisitionList.Title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Design, build, and operate the platform capabilities that enable OCI services to be understood, changed, tested, and operated more safely through AI-enabled engineering. 

You will independently own significant components end to end, from technical design and implementation through production reliability and solve complex distributed-systems and developer-productivity problems. You will partner with service teams to turn fragmented operational knowledge and manual workflows into reusable, secure, and observable platform capabilities. This role calls for strong technical judgment, a bias for durable engineering solutions, and the ability to influence designs and outcomes beyond your immediate area of ownership.

requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Drive maximum adoption of Oracle solution and identify/drive product expansion opportunities via high value relationship with the client.
